risks.risk: Battery health is poor or degraded (1% battery lasting only 30 minutes)
risks.proof: A battery health check screenshot from Settings > Battery > Battery health (or similar) showing cycle count and capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having poor battery health, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: Phone is not factory unlocked or has carrier restrictions
risks.proof: Screenshot of Settings > Connections > SIM card manager or 'About phone' showing 'Network lock' status as 'None' or 'Unlocked'.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially locked, which reduces value for buyers wanting to use any SIM.

risks.risk: Screen damage not visible in photos (e.g., dead pixels, touch issues, or internal cracks)
risks.proof: Video of screen being touched across all areas, and a full-screen white test to check for dead pixels or discoloration.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as screen may have hidden defects, reducing value.

risks.risk: Water damage or internal issues not visible externally
risks.proof: Photo of the phone's SIM tray, charging port, and speaker grills showing no corrosion or moisture. Also, a video of the phone charging and audio output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially water-damaged, which reduces value.

Photo of SIM tray, charging port, and speaker grills to check for water damage.
